limitations: All 124 numbered letters appear in the keyboarded transcription, including Lipsius’s prefatory arguments and six marginal notes. The TCP identifies 1,450 gap markers across these letters and their arguments: illegible and omitted foreign text are explicitly marked; ten duplicate-page markers do not represent a loss of transcribed text. The source labels the 69th letter LXXIX; its position and opening match letter 69, while the later 79th letter is distinct. Navigation uses 69 and retains the source heading in the source metadata. End-of-line hyphen markers are joined and the four abbreviation marks for -que are rendered {que}; spacing is normalized. Source spelling and uncertainties remain; no scan collation or critical text review is claimed.
